'''NAEA Lakewood power station''' is a mothballed power station in Lakewood, Ocean, New Jersey, United States.

==Background==

The private equity firm Carlyle Group acquired Lakewood Power Station in February of 2016, and as of 2022 still owns it . More information about this deal can be found on GEM's "[[Carlyle's private equity investments|Carlyle's Private Equity Investments]]" Wiki page.
